name: Left ventricular mass to end-diastolic volume ratio
description: Quantification of the ratio of left ventricular mass to end-diastolic volume. Elevated left ventricular mass/end-diastolic volume ratio has been associated with higher evidence of myocardial fibrosis and dysfunction in hypertensive patients
